# Let's Study MS — School of Mathematics
> Mathematics institute in Khardaha, Kolkata (West Bengal, India), founded in 2022 and affiliated with the Ramanujan School of Mathematics (RSM). Expert preparation for BSc Honours, MSc entrances (IIT JAM, ISI, TIFR, NBHM, CMI), M.Tech / Data Science / MSc Economics, engineering mathematics and PhD entrances. Faculty from IIT, ISI and IISc.

Every page below is also available as Markdown: add `.md` to the URL (the home page is /index.md) or send `Accept: text/markdown`. A read-only MCP server is available at https://letsstudyms.com/mcp (server card: https://letsstudyms.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json).

## About
- [Home](https://letsstudyms.com/index.md): Overview of the institute, courses, mentors and success stories

- [Contact](https://letsstudyms.com/contact.md): Enquiry form, phone numbers, email and address

## Courses
- [Foundation Batch](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/foundation-batch.md): Strong mathematical fundamentals for undergraduate students
- [Semester Batch](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/semester-batch.md): Targeted preparation for semester exams
- [MSc Mathematics Entrances](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/msc-mathematics.md): IIT JAM, TIFR, ISI, NBHM, CMI entrance coaching
- [MTech / Data Science / MSc Economics](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/mtech-datascience.md): Preparation for interdisciplinary programmes
- [Engineering Mathematics](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/engineering-mathematics.md): Engineering mathematics for all branches
- [PhD Entrances](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/phd-entrances.md): Preparation for doctoral admissions
- [Advanced Courses](https://letsstudyms.com/courses/advanced-courses.md): Research-level topics

## Success Stories
- [Hall of Fame](https://letsstudyms.com/testimonials.md): Alumni results — IIT JAM AIR 37, CSIR NET AIR 6, GATE AIR 25; alumni at ISI Kolkata, IISc Bangalore, TIFR, HRI, IIT Bombay, University of Connecticut (PhD)
